# Weekly linking review, 2026-11-09

First report. There is no earlier file in docs/linking-reviews/, so section 5 is a baseline.
Method: `npm ci`, `npm run build`, then parsed the 95 built pages in `dist/`. Only links inside `<main>` count. Header nav, footer, breadcrumbs, the /blog/ index and category listings are excluded.

"Template" means a link block generated by a layout (related cards, prev/next, `*-next` rows, zoning links, CTA boxes, price rows). "Editorial" means everything else in the body. The split is a heuristic based on CSS class names. Treat counts as close, not exact.

## 1. Orphans and near-orphans (editorial inbound 0-2)

No page has zero inbound links of any kind. Template blocks keep every page reachable. The gap is editorial links.

| Page | Editorial in | Template in | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| /locations/ohio/cleveland-shipping-containers/ | 0 | 4 | City page |
| /locations/{georgia,michigan,missouri,new-york,north-carolina,south-carolina,virginia}/ city pages | 0 | 3-4 | 7 city pages, no editorial links |
| /locations/{georgia,michigan,missouri,new-york,north-carolina,south-carolina,virginia}/ state hubs | 0 | 2 | |
| /permits/{georgia,indiana,kentucky,michigan,missouri,new-york,north-carolina,ohio,south-carolina,virginia,west-virginia}/ | 0 | 3-7 | 11 of 12 permit pages. Only Texas has 1 |
| /locations/ohio/columbus-, louisville-, indianapolis- city pages | 1 | 9 | |

Commercial pages in good shape: /quote/ (21 editorial), /rent-to-own/ (11), /delivery/ (11), /cost/ (9), the three product pages (9-10 each), /condition/ (18).
Weaker: /for/farmers/ (3), /for/homeowners/ (4), /for/businesses/ (5), /conex-boxes-for-sale/ (4).

## 4. Broken internal links

None found. One false positive: `/price/` appears in 11 pages but is not in `dist/`. It is server-rendered (`prerender = false`) and listed in `_routes.json`, so it works.

## 5. Changes since last report

First report. Baseline set. Nothing fixed, open or new to compare yet.

## 6. Top 10 fixes by expected impact

1. Add one editorial link each from state and city pages to the 7 city pages and hubs with 0 editorial inbound (Cleveland, Savannah, Detroit, Kansas City, New York, Charleston, Norfolk). Commercial pages with the least support.
2. Give the 11 /permits/{state}/ pages editorial inbound, e.g. link "oversize permit" in the dimensions post to /permits/ and add state-specific links from city blog posts. Use link-only, no permit determinations.
3. Publish the Charlotte and WV deer camp drafts, then link each from its city page. Fact-check ledger entry first.
4. Link houston-after-hurricane-season from the Houston city page and /permits/texas/ (NEW COPY, fact-check).
5. Raise /size/calculator/ from 2 editorial inbound. Link "which size" language in the dimensions and 20ft-vs-40ft posts and the /for/* pages.
6. Link /iso-6346-check-digit-calculator/ from "check digit" in check-used-bic (verbatim phrase above).
7. Add /condition/ and /delivery/ links to 99-dollar-down-rent-to-own (link only, no wording change).
8. Link 99-dollar-down from /container-rental-guide/ and the rent-vs-buy calculator.
9. Strengthen /for/farmers/ (3 editorial) and /for/homeowners/ (4). Wrap "farm" and "homeowner" terms in published posts and in the pole barn and shed drafts at publish time.
10. Rewrite sample-container-vs-pole-barn (420 words, one link) before it ships.
